$schema.description: Optional URL of the published schema for editor tooling; has no effect on validation.

languages.description: Content languages actually provided in this course (1–2 of "vi", "en"). This is not the learner interface language.

modules.description: 1–60 modules, each holding the course items in order.

CourseDocument.description: A whole course: schemaVersion 1, kind "course", id, title, summary, languages, defaultLanguage, level, difficulty, pathway, learningOutcomes, access and modules. "languages" lists the content languages actually provided and must include defaultLanguage.

Id.description: Identifier: lowercase a-z, 0-9 and "-", 1–64 characters, starting with a letter or digit, e.g. "cau-1". Uppercase, spaces and underscores are rejected. Ids must be unique within their own list.

L10nString.description: A short text: either a plain string, or a map with "vi" and/or "en" keys when the content is bilingual, e.g. "Phân số" or {"vi":"Phân số","en":"Fractions"}.

L10nRichContent.description: RichContent, either directly ({"blocks":[{"type":"paragraph","content":[{"text":"…"}]}]}) or as a bilingual map {"vi":{"blocks":[…]},"en":{"blocks":[…]}}. This is the type of every "content", "explanation", "hint", "intro", "instructions" and "description" field — a plain string is rejected.

RichContent.description: Formatted text, always an object with a "blocks" array. The minimal form is {"blocks":[{"type":"paragraph","content":[{"text":"…"}]}]}. Used for question stems, options, explanations, hints, lesson paragraphs and instructions — none of these accept a plain string.

ContentBlock.description: One block of formatted content, chosen by "type": paragraph, heading, list, quote, image, video, audio, table, code, divider, embed, pdf, callout, math or diagram. Every block type has its own required fields; a paragraph needs "content" (Runs).

Runs.description: The inline content of a paragraph, heading, quote, list item or table cell: an array of TextRun (and, in fill_blank stems only, BlankRun). It is an array of objects, never a bare string.

TextRun.description: One run of inline text: {"text":"…"} with optional "annotations" (bold, italic, link…). "text" may be a bilingual map. There is no other inline shape for plain words.

Annotations.description: Inline formatting flags for one TextRun. Omit when the text is plain.

BlankRun.description: A blank inside a fill_blank question stem: {"blank":"<blank id>"}. The id must appear in the question's "blanks" list and in its "correctAnswer".

ListItem.description: One list entry: {"content":<Runs>} with optional nested "items" for a sub-list. "content" is an array of TextRun objects, not a string.

MediaRef.description: A media reference: {"assetId":"…"} for an uploaded asset in the media library, or {"url":"https://…"} for an allowlisted host. Never invent an assetId.

CourseAccess.description: Who may see the course: {"scope":"global"} or {"scope":"branches","branchIds":[…]}.

CompletionRule.description: One course completion rule, chosen by "type": all_items, lessons_completed, exam_passed, assignment_approved or quiz_min_score.

sections.description: 1–20 ExamSection entries; the whole exam may hold at most 200 questions.

ManifestItem.description: An entry in a course module. Either a complete inline item — {"type":"lesson",…blocks} / {"type":"exam",…sections} / {"type":"assignment",…instructions,submission} — or a stub {"type","id","title"?} whose document is supplied separately. Inline items use "type", not "kind", and carry no schemaVersion or $schema. A course JSON meant to be imported on its own must inline every item.

LessonBlock.description: One block of a lesson, chosen by "type": any ContentBlock type, or an activity — quiz, assignment, reflection, flashcards, accordion, tabs, reveal, stepper, resource_link, opportunity_link, next_step.

QuizBlock.description: A quiz inside a lesson: {"id","type":"quiz","title"?,"intro"?,"settings"?,"questions":[…]} with 1–50 entries. Only auto-graded question types are allowed (single_choice, multiple_choice, true_false, fill_blank, short_answer, numeric, matching, ordering, classification); essay, upload_answer and code_answer must go in an exam or assignment, or carry selfAssessment true.

QuizQuestionEntry.description: One entry of a lesson quiz: an inline Question or a QuestionRef.

QuestionRef.description: A reference to a published question-bank item: {"$ref":"bank:<question-id>"}. Only for ids that already exist in the bank; never invent one.

Question.description: Any question, chosen by its "type": single_choice, multiple_choice, true_false, fill_blank, short_answer, numeric, matching, ordering, classification, essay, upload_answer, code_answer or question_group. There is no "mcq", "multiple_select" or free-form type.

points.description: Points for this question, 0–1000. Defaults to 1 when omitted; the guide convention is to always set it.

selfAssessment.description: true marks an unscored self-check question. It is the only way a manually graded type (essay, upload_answer, code_answer) may appear inside a lesson quiz; do not use it to skip writing a correctAnswer on an auto-graded type.

skills.description: Optional skill ids declared by the course. Do not invent skill ids.

options.description: 2–10 Option objects with unique ids; the correct one is named by correctAnswer.

correctAnswer.description: The id of the correct Option, e.g. "b" — an existing option id, never a position number or the option text.

SingleChoiceQuestion.description: One correct option among 2–10 "options". Required: id, type "single_choice", content (L10nRichContent), options. correctAnswer is the id of the correct Option, e.g. "b".

QuestionSettings.description: Optional per-question behaviour flags (shuffleOptions, partialScoring, caseSensitive, ignoreAccents, decimalComma). Omit unless the author asked for one.

Display.description: Optional rendering hints. Do not set "interactionType" unless a specific player was requested; the default renderer is chosen automatically.

Option.description: One answer option: {"id":"a","content":<L10nRichContent>} plus optional per-option "feedback". "content" is RichContent, not a string; there is no "text", "label" or "isCorrect" field — correctness lives in the question's "correctAnswer".

points.description: Points for this question, 0–1000. Defaults to 1 when omitted; the guide convention is to always set it.

selfAssessment.description: true marks an unscored self-check question. It is the only way a manually graded type (essay, upload_answer, code_answer) may appear inside a lesson quiz; do not use it to skip writing a correctAnswer on an auto-graded type.

skills.description: Optional skill ids declared by the course. Do not invent skill ids.

correctAnswer.description: Array of the correct Option ids, e.g. ["a","c"] — existing ids, no duplicates, never positions.

MultipleChoiceQuestion.description: Several correct options among 2–12 "options". correctAnswer is an array of Option ids, e.g. ["a","c"]. Optional minSelections/maxSelections bound how many the learner may pick.

points.description: Points for this question, 0–1000. Defaults to 1 when omitted; the guide convention is to always set it.

selfAssessment.description: true marks an unscored self-check question. It is the only way a manually graded type (essay, upload_answer, code_answer) may appear inside a lesson quiz; do not use it to skip writing a correctAnswer on an auto-graded type.

skills.description: Optional skill ids declared by the course. Do not invent skill ids.

correctAnswer.description: The boolean true or false — not a string.

TrueFalseQuestion.description: A true/false statement in "content". correctAnswer is the boolean true or false (not the string "true"). Optional "labels" rename the two choices.

points.description: Points for this question, 0–1000. Defaults to 1 when omitted; the guide convention is to always set it.

selfAssessment.description: true marks an unscored self-check question. It is the only way a manually graded type (essay, upload_answer, code_answer) may appear inside a lesson quiz; do not use it to skip writing a correctAnswer on an auto-graded type.

skills.description: Optional skill ids declared by the course. Do not invent skill ids.

blanks.description: Every blank used in the stem, as {"id":"blank-1"}; ids must match the {"blank":…} runs and the correctAnswer keys.

correctAnswer.description: Object mapping each blank id to one accepted string or an array of accepted strings.

FillBlankQuestion.description: A stem whose Runs include {"blank":"<id>"} entries, one per blank declared in "blanks". correctAnswer maps each blank id to an accepted string or array of accepted strings, e.g. {"blank-1":["Hà Nội","Ha Noi"]}.

points.description: Points for this question, 0–1000. Defaults to 1 when omitted; the guide convention is to always set it.

selfAssessment.description: true marks an unscored self-check question. It is the only way a manually graded type (essay, upload_answer, code_answer) may appear inside a lesson quiz; do not use it to skip writing a correctAnswer on an auto-graded type.

skills.description: Optional skill ids declared by the course. Do not invent skill ids.

ShortAnswerQuestion.description: A typed short answer compared with "correctAnswer": an array of accepted strings, e.g. ["Hà Nội","Ha Noi"]. matchMode defaults to "exact"; "regex" patterns must be simple and bounded.

points.description: Points for this question, 0–1000. Defaults to 1 when omitted; the guide convention is to always set it.

selfAssessment.description: true marks an unscored self-check question. It is the only way a manually graded type (essay, upload_answer, code_answer) may appear inside a lesson quiz; do not use it to skip writing a correctAnswer on an auto-graded type.

skills.description: Optional skill ids declared by the course. Do not invent skill ids.

correctAnswer.description: The correct value as a JSON number, e.g. 12.5.

NumericQuestion.description: A numeric answer. correctAnswer is a JSON number, e.g. 12.5 — no unit inside it; put the unit in "unit". Use at most one of "tolerance" or "tolerancePercent".

points.description: Points for this question, 0–1000. Defaults to 1 when omitted; the guide convention is to always set it.

selfAssessment.description: true marks an unscored self-check question. It is the only way a manually graded type (essay, upload_answer, code_answer) may appear inside a lesson quiz; do not use it to skip writing a correctAnswer on an auto-graded type.

skills.description: Optional skill ids declared by the course. Do not invent skill ids.

correctAnswer.description: Array of {"left","right"} id pairs covering every left item.

MatchingQuestion.description: Match every "left" item to a "right" item. correctAnswer is an array of {"left":"<left id>","right":"<right id>"} covering every left item; a right item may repeat only when allowManyToOne is true.

PairItem.description: One item in a matching, ordering or classification list: {"id":"…","content":<L10nRichContent>}.

points.description: Points for this question, 0–1000. Defaults to 1 when omitted; the guide convention is to always set it.

selfAssessment.description: true marks an unscored self-check question. It is the only way a manually graded type (essay, upload_answer, code_answer) may appear inside a lesson quiz; do not use it to skip writing a correctAnswer on an auto-graded type.

skills.description: Optional skill ids declared by the course. Do not invent skill ids.

correctAnswer.description: The item ids in correct order — every item exactly once.

OrderingQuestion.description: Put "items" in the correct order. correctAnswer is the array of item ids in the correct order, containing every item exactly once.

points.description: Points for this question, 0–1000. Defaults to 1 when omitted; the guide convention is to always set it.

selfAssessment.description: true marks an unscored self-check question. It is the only way a manually graded type (essay, upload_answer, code_answer) may appear inside a lesson quiz; do not use it to skip writing a correctAnswer on an auto-graded type.

skills.description: Optional skill ids declared by the course. Do not invent skill ids.

correctAnswer.description: Object mapping every item id to a category id.

ClassificationQuestion.description: Sort "items" into "categories". correctAnswer maps every item id to a category id, e.g. {"i1":"cat-a","i2":"cat-b"}.

points.description: Points for this question, 0–1000. Defaults to 1 when omitted; the guide convention is to always set it.

selfAssessment.description: true marks an unscored self-check question. It is the only way a manually graded type (essay, upload_answer, code_answer) may appear inside a lesson quiz; do not use it to skip writing a correctAnswer on an auto-graded type.

skills.description: Optional skill ids declared by the course. Do not invent skill ids.

EssayQuestion.description: A free-text answer graded by a teacher with a "rubric". There is no correctAnswer field — including one is rejected. Not allowed inside a lesson quiz unless selfAssessment is true.

Rubric.description: Grading rubric for manually graded questions and assignments: {"criteria":[{"id","name","maxPoints"…}]} with 1–12 criteria. Each criterion has an Id, an L10nString "name", an optional "description", "maxPoints" 0–100 and optional scoring "levels". The criteria maxPoints normally add up to the question's "points".

points.description: Points for this question, 0–1000. Defaults to 1 when omitted; the guide convention is to always set it.

selfAssessment.description: true marks an unscored self-check question. It is the only way a manually graded type (essay, upload_answer, code_answer) may appear inside a lesson quiz; do not use it to skip writing a correctAnswer on an auto-graded type.

skills.description: Optional skill ids declared by the course. Do not invent skill ids.

UploadAnswerQuestion.description: A file, link or text submission graded by a teacher with a "rubric". "accepts" lists the allowed submission kinds. No correctAnswer field. Not allowed inside a lesson quiz unless selfAssessment is true.

points.description: Points for this question, 0–1000. Defaults to 1 when omitted; the guide convention is to always set it.

selfAssessment.description: true marks an unscored self-check question. It is the only way a manually graded type (essay, upload_answer, code_answer) may appear inside a lesson quiz; do not use it to skip writing a correctAnswer on an auto-graded type.

skills.description: Optional skill ids declared by the course. Do not invent skill ids.

language.description: Programming language of the expected answer; one of the listed values only.

starterCode.description: Optional code the learner starts from, as a plain string (use \n for line breaks).

sampleSolution.description: Optional reference solution for the grader, as a plain string. Not shown to learners.

CodeAnswerQuestion.description: Source code submitted for manual grading with a "rubric". "language" must be one of the listed values; optional "starterCode" and "sampleSolution" are plain strings. No correctAnswer field and no test-case fields. Not allowed inside a lesson quiz unless selfAssessment is true.

points.description: Points for this question, 0–1000. Defaults to 1 when omitted; the guide convention is to always set it.

selfAssessment.description: true marks an unscored self-check question. It is the only way a manually graded type (essay, upload_answer, code_answer) may appear inside a lesson quiz; do not use it to skip writing a correctAnswer on an auto-graded type.

skills.description: Optional skill ids declared by the course. Do not invent skill ids.

QuestionGroup.description: A shared passage ("sharedContent", L10nRichContent) followed by 1–20 sub-questions in "questions". Answers and points belong to each sub-question; a group cannot contain another group.

LeafQuestion.description: Any question type except question_group, chosen by "type".

QuizSettings.description: Behaviour of a lesson quiz block. For a practice quiz the guide uses {"mode":"practice","feedback":"after_submit","showExplanations":true}. These keys are not valid in exam settings.

AssignmentBlock.description: An assignment embedded in a lesson, with "instructions" (L10nRichContent), "submission" (SubmissionSpec) and an optional "rubric".

SubmissionSpec.description: What an assignment accepts: "accepts" is a non-empty array of "text", "link", "file", "code"; optional file/link limits.

NotebookAssignment.description: Optional notebook configuration for a coding assignment; requires uploaded template and dataset assets.

NotebookDataset.description: One dataset file attached to a notebook assignment.

ReflectionBlock.description: An unscored written reflection prompt inside a lesson.

FlashcardsBlock.description: A deck of flashcards, each with "front" and "back" L10nRichContent.

ResourceLinkBlock.description: A link to an existing published resource by id. Do not invent resource ids.

OpportunityLinkBlock.description: A link to an existing opportunity by id.

NextStepBlock.description: A "what next" pointer to a lesson, exam, course, opportunity or URL.

timeLimitMinutes.description: Whole exam time limit in minutes, 1–600.

availability.description: Optional open/close window as ISO 8601 date-times. Omit unless the author gave concrete dates.

review.description: When learners may see score, correct answers and explanations: each of showScore, showCorrectAnswers, showExplanations is "immediately", "on_release" or "never".

ExamSettings.description: Exam-level behaviour: timeLimitMinutes 1–600, attemptsAllowed 1–20, passPercent 0–100, navigation "free"|"sequential", layout, review visibility, optional availability window. Only set what the author asked for; never invent dates.

ExamSection.description: A section of an exam: {"id","title","instructions"?,"timeLimitMinutes"?,"questions":[…]} with 1–200 entries. If any section has timeLimitMinutes, every section must.

ExamQuestionEntry.description: One entry of an exam section: an inline Question, a QuestionRef or a PoolDraw.

PoolDraw.description: Draws "count" questions at random from the question bank, by explicit "from" ids or by "filter". Only for existing bank content.

$schema.description: Optional URL of the published schema for editor tooling; has no effect on validation.

languages.description: Optional list of content languages a standalone item provides. Leave it out unless the target course configuration is known; the course settings win on import.

defaultLanguage.description: Optional default language for a standalone item; must be in "languages".

LessonDocument.description: A standalone lesson: {"schemaVersion":1,"kind":"lesson","id","title","blocks":[LessonBlock…]}. A practice quiz is a QuizBlock inside "blocks" — there is no "quiz" document kind.

$schema.description: Optional URL of the published schema for editor tooling; has no effect on validation.

languages.description: Optional list of content languages a standalone item provides. Leave it out unless the target course configuration is known; the course settings win on import.

defaultLanguage.description: Optional default language for a standalone item; must be in "languages".

sections.description: 1–20 ExamSection entries; the whole exam may hold at most 200 questions.

ExamDocument.description: A standalone exam or test: {"schemaVersion":1,"kind":"exam","id","title","settings"?,"sections":[ExamSection…]}. Questions live in sections[].questions[].

languages.description: Optional list of content languages a standalone item provides. Leave it out unless the target course configuration is known; the course settings win on import.

defaultLanguage.description: Optional default language for a standalone item; must be in "languages".

title: VFuture Studio content payload v1
description: A complete course with inline items, or a standalone lesson, exam, or assignment. All schema references are contained in this file. Runtime validation is still required for semantic rules.
